questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: While supplies > 0, remove one supply. Starting with supplies = 4, how many iterations run?
questions.explanation: Four removals reduce the value to zero, where the condition becomes false.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A pre-test while loop checks ready == false. If ready is already true, how many iterations run?
questions.explanation: The condition is false before the first iteration.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: While count < 3, print count and increase it by 1. Starting at count = 1, what is printed?
questions.explanation: Values one and two satisfy the condition; three does not.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Loops
questions.text: A loop waits while jobsRemaining > 0 but never changes jobsRemaining. What is a concern?
answers: It must stop after one iteration
questions.explanation: The condition may remain true if nothing changes the relevant state.
